title: Shoulder Mobility
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for shoulder mobility
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the role of combined stretching, strengthening, and neuromotor control exercises to improve shoulder mobility, with moderate evidence for specific modalities such as PNF stretching. Emerging research continues to refine optimal protocols and progression schemes. Safety precautions are well supported in clinical guidelines.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
